Name: King Kai's Weapon and Magic Expansion
Author: ThatKingKai
Description:
[center]I'm sorry I have taken a step back from modding, I have not been intentionally ignoring everyone! I have been devoting all of my spare time to developing my own game! 

Obviously, my game has no relevance to this mod, but nevertheless I feel I should at least showcase why I have been absent for so long. 

Introducing; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458750/Wardens_of_Wen/]Wardens of Wen, available on Steam now[/url]![/center]
[center]
Once my game has had it's full release and I have less personal pressure I plan to get back to modding once again! Thank you for your interest in my mod, and for your patience![/center]
